tagline: Custom booking system built around Velvet Cleaning Co.
painPoint: You said it yourself — you're tired of having to chase payment down after the job's already done. This flips the order: clients pay when they book, so the cancellation and late-payment headaches never get a chance to start.
demoSubtitle: Clients pay when they book — no more last-minute cancellations costing you the slot, no more chasing anyone afterward.
features: Payment collected upfront at booking, before the job ever starts
Cancellation policy enforces itself — no awkward conversations needed
Every booking lands in one calendar, no double-checking texts and DMs
One-time cost, no monthly fee stacked on top of what you already use
